description: External runtime configuration names and public-key file structure; values are placeholders, not credentials.

properties.KNODE_AUTH_SIGNING_PUBLIC_FILE: <external-public-PEM-file; fallback only when trusted map not set>
properties.KNODE_AUTH_TRUSTED_PUBLIC_KEYS_FILE: <external-JSON-file mapping kid to external RSA public PEM file path; include current and previous key during overlap>

rotation: Restart to load changed trust configuration. Private key must match active public key. Configure verifier overlap everywhere before changing active signer; retire old key after expiry.

endpoints.POST /internal/v1/auth/service-tokens: Basic service-id:bootstrap-secret; only configured identity and requested audience/permission intersection
endpoints.POST /internal/v1/users/public-profiles:: Bearer service token, aud knode-user, users:public:read
endpoints.POST /internal/v1/users/validity:batch: Bearer service token, aud knode-user, users:state:read
endpoints.GET /internal/v1/auth/keys: Bearer service token, aud knode-user, auth:keys:read; public JWK only
